subject: Target signals & orchestration — handoff for QBR readiness
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Melanie Ortiz <melanie.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Target signals & orchestration — handoff for QBR readiness

Team,

I pulled together the initial target signals matrix and a short QBR readiness checklist to ensure we have a crisp narrative for the exec review on Nov 25. Core ask: please review the proposed Base / Conservative / Upside scenarios and confirm the signal thresholds and owner assignments by EOD Friday (Nov 20).

Highlights:
- Attached: "2026_target_signal_matrix.xlsx" (tabs: signals, thresholds, glidepath) and "QBR_readiness_checklist.pdf".
- Proposed decision policy: changes >=10% headcount or >=12% cost delta trigger an exec readout; smaller deltas route to finance+product for fast follow.
- Region breakdown: US / EU primary; APAC modeled as tail with sensitivity only.

Decision needed from this thread:
1) Confirm scenario naming and numeric thresholds (Jonas).
2) Confirm staffing glidepath & staging windows (Marissa).
3) Finance confirmation of revenue runway assumptions (Vivek + Melanie).

Quick timeline:
- Nov 20 EOD: internal sign-off on matrix
- Nov 22: prep deck due to comms (one-pager + appendix)
- Nov 25: Exec QBR (we present changes + contingency plan)

If you want me to split the matrix by product line before Friday, say so — I can turn around a product-view by tomorrow noon.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026_target_signal_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), QBR_readiness_checklist.pdf (doc)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Melanie Ortiz <melanie.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Target signals & orchestration — handoff for QBR readiness

Thanks Irene — this is excellent. Quick notes after a pass through the matrix: 

- Thresholds: I suggest moving the revenue-related trigger from 12% to 10% for product lines with >$500k ARR; smaller SKUs can keep 12%. That better aligns with our historical sensitivity.
- Glidepath windows: propose a 6-week staging for hiring freezes and a 12-week ramp-down for planned reductions to avoid abrupt capacity hits.
- Product split: yes — please split by LLM and infra-facing products. The growth & cost dynamics are materially different.

Actionable: I can take the product split and update the "signals" tab by end of day. If others agree on the 10% revenue threshold for large SKUs, I'll apply it across the product-view.

On the exec one-pager: let's include the operational fallout table (risk, mitigation, owner) on the back of the doc.

Jonas
VP, Product Operations

All,

Good work. A couple of finance-oriented notes: 

- Revenue assumptions: Melanie — can you confirm the FY27 macro assumptions used in the attached model? If those are conservative we can widen the Base band slightly.
- Contingency: I'd like a small, rapid-fallback plan ("canary pool") that reduces non-customer facing spend by ~8% within two weeks for downside scenarios. Please add owners for the canary pool actions.
- Exec summary: please produce a 1-page summary focused on impacts to ARR runway, customer SLAs (latency), and hiring commitments. I'll need this for the Friday leadership pre-read.

Irene — if you can accept the product-level split from Jonas and add the canary actions (owner + timeline), we'll be in good shape.

Vivek
Chief Operating Officer

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Melanie Ortiz <melanie.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Target signals & orchestration — handoff for QBR readiness

Review complete — thank you all for the quick turns. Summary of changes and owners (updated attachments: exec-summary-onepager.pdf attached):

1) Product split applied (Jonas) — product tabs added, 10% revenue trigger applied for SKUs >$500k ARR.
2) Glidepath windows standardized (Marissa) — 6-week staging / 12-week ramp for reductions.
3) Canary pool defined (Vivek) — owner: Marissa; actions: hiring freeze on new reqs, pause non-critical infra spend, temporary vendor reprioritization. Canary can be executed in 10 business days.
4) Finance assumptions: Melanie to confirm macro inputs; if no changes by EOD Monday Nov 23, we'll proceed with current base.
5) Exec one-pager produced (Irene) — attached: exec-summary-onepager.pdf and updated matrix.

Next steps / deliverables:
- Nov 22 COB: Deck to Comms (one-pager + appendix) — owner: Irene / Jonas
- Nov 23 EOD: Finance confirmation or escalation to Vivek — owner: Melanie / Vivek
- Nov 25 09:00am: Exec QBR slot (TBC) — presenters: Vivek + Jonas

If anyone cannot meet these timelines, flag now. Otherwise I'll route the final folder to comms and attach the deck links to the leadership calendar invite.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachments: exec-summary-onepager.pdf (doc), 2026_target_signal_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
